name: Divine Dawn
source: As an aspiring hero, you stumble into an ancient prison and release an angel imprisoned in a previous age. Having freed the angel, you join her on a journey to discover her place in a world which has long since concluded the war she was meant to fight. To her dismay, you are joined by two of her demonic guards, also trying to adapt to the modern world, and an eclectic group of others.
